title: Run coding agents where work can continue

slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Run coding agents where work can continue
slides.subtitle: Long-running agent work should survive disconnects.

slides.title: Local is fine first
slides.body: For small experiments, your laptop is enough. Do not add remote infrastructure before you need it.

slides.title: The failure mode
slides.body: If a process is attached directly to SSH, it can die when the connection dies.

slides.title: tmux helps
slides.body: Run the coding-agent session inside tmux, disconnect, and attach again later when you are back.

slides.title: Why it matters
slides.body: Agent tasks can read a repo, edit files, run tests, inspect errors, and try again. That work can take time.
